decisions.vote_totals_release: Withheld until the election is certified

commitments.detail: Update the election plan to replace the online ballot with sealed paper ballots counted by two adults, with zero electronic voter records, ensuring ballots do not identify voters in any way.
Follow up with the communications office to expedite translations of all election instructions, ballots, and candidate statements into English, Spanish, and Arabic, and report back on status.
Ensure the sealed paper ballot process is consistent with anonymous voting requirements — specifically that paper ballots do not identify voters in any way.
Review the revised plan from a student-safety and privacy standpoint to confirm anonymous voting and delayed vote-total release are properly reflected.
Review the revised plan from a technology standpoint to confirm ballot logistics are sound.
Review the revised plan from a family-engagement standpoint to confirm all materials are accessible across English, Spanish, and Arabic.
Review and approve the final revised plan once all three sets of changes are incorporated and reviewed by the three reviewers.
